text: dsh-ui-cost 是面向 DSH Web 的会话统计栏插件，通过浏览器客户端在对话输入区的统计栏位置接管原有 stats 单元，展示回合与步骤数、模型和工具耗时、首 token 延迟、生成速度、缓存命中比例及 token 数。它依据会话 token 使用量和当前选择的 DeepSeek 模型估算人民币费用，并随模型选择更新；未收录价格的模型不会显示费用。适合希望在聊天过程中查看用量与费用估算的 DSH Web 用户。安装使用 DSH 插件命令，无需额外密钥配置。

dsh-ui-cost adds token counts and estimated DeepSeek cost to the DSH Web conversation stats strip. It shows session timing and cache data, estimating CNY charges from usage and the selected model. Models without listed rates have no cost figure; no extra key is configured.
想在 DSH 对话里同时看到 token 用量和大致费用。
DSH 的会话统计栏能显示模型调用耗时和缓存命中率吗？
I want to see an estimated DeepSeek cost next to my conversation stats.
dsh-ui-cost 的功能「会话用量与费用统计」：在对话输入区统计栏展示回合、步骤、耗时、token 和缓存命中信息，并按当前 DeepSeek 模型及 token 分类估算人民币费用；未覆盖的模型不显示费用。

dsh-ui-cost README · dsh-ui-cost：English | [中文](README.zh.md)

Self-contained stats strip with an estimated cost, contributed as a pure DSH browser plugin — **no modification to the ui-conversation core**, so a DSH/DSH Desktop upgrade that restores the stock core cannot break it.

This is a community plugin and is not affiliated with DeepSeek AI.

dsh-ui-cost README · dsh-ui-cost：The plugin registers on the same `conversation.composer.dock` cell as the core stats entry (`id: 'stats'`) with a lower shadowing priority, taking over the whole line: turn/step counts, LLM and tool wall times, TTFT/decode throughput, cache-hit share, billed tokens, and the cost. If the plugin ever crashes, the cell's shadowing retires it and the stock core strip renders instead. Composing this plugin out of cordis.yml removes the whole replacement and the stock strip returns.

dsh-ui-cost README · dsh-ui-cost：The cost prices the durable `tokenUsage` projection (uncached input + cache writes at the cache-miss input rate, cache reads at the hit rate, output at the output rate) at the session's CURRENT model selection, read live from the ui-model-selection model directory — so a model switch re-prices immediately. Rates come from the official [Models & Pricing](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/quick_start/pricing) page (CNY per 1M tokens, `deepseek-v4-flash` / `deepseek-v4-pro`) and follow its announced peak/off-peak schedule automatically — peak is 09:00–12:00 and 14:00–18:00 Beijing time, off-peak is half (effective 2026-08-17 00:00 Beijing; the flat table is billed before that).

dsh-ui-cost README · Install：The package declares `dsh.bundle` (its `cordis.patch.yml` inserts the `ui-cost` row) and `dsh.client` (the browser bundle). The repository includes the built `lib/` artifacts, so a GitHub install does not need to run an install-time build script:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:uaapple/dsh-ui-cost
```

For a reproducible install, pin the command to a full commit SHA. If the package is later published to npm, the equivalent command is `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-ui-cost`.

dsh-ui-cost README · Install：To mount the row manually instead of using the bundle manifest:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: ui-cost
      name: dsh-ui-cost
```

The GitHub repository should carry the `dsh-plugin` topic so it appears in DSH community indexes and search pages.

dsh-ui-cost README · Development：```sh
npm install
npm run check
npm test
```

The supported runtime is Node.js 22 or newer. DSH itself is still in developer preview, so compatibility follows the DSH client package versions declared in `package.json`.
